newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU calls on Israel not to let attack derail peace.
newsitem.headline: EU calls on Israel not to let attack derail peace.

text.p: The European Union strongly condemned the bombing in Jerusalem on Wednesday and urged Israelis not to let the attack derail the peace process.

"The European Union presidency calls on the government and people of Israel not to be provoked by those who want to torpedo peace," Luxembourg Foreign Minister Jacques Poos said in a statement on behalf of the 15-nation bloc.
Israeli police said on Wednesday that two suicide bombers had killed 11 people in an attack on a Jerusalem street market.
Poos said the EU "condemned as strongly as possible the cowardly attack" which was part of a series of acts directed against the Middle East peace process.
The statement extended the EU's condolences to the government and people of Israel and to the families of the victims.
